WITH siparis_tutarlar AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) as toplam
    FROM siparisler s
    JOIN musteriler m ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.id, m.sehir
),
sehir_istatistikleri AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        COUNT(*) as siparis_sayisi,
        AVG(toplam) as medyan
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            sehir,
            toplam,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sehir ORDER BY toplam ASC) as rn,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sehir) as total_count
        FROM siparis_tutarlar
    )
    WHERE rn IN ((total_count + 1) / 2, total_count / 2 + 1)
    GROUP BY sehir
)
SELECT 
    sehir,
    siparis_sayisi,
    ROUND(medyan, 2) as medyan
FROM sehir_istatistikleri
WHERE siparis_sayisi >= 2
ORDER BY medyan DESC, sehir ASC;
